header.name: MeOHprodCOSOEC21
header.authors_and_contributors: Daniel Flórez-Orrego, Meire Ribeiro Domingos, EPFL IPESE research group
header.description: Methanol is synthesised from the 2:1 (H/C) syngas of a CO2/H2O co-electrolysis (CO-SOEC) unit in an isothermal reactor, the purge is burned in an oxy-fired flare, and a distillation column separates methanol from heavies and water.
header.references: [1] Ribeiro Domingos, M.E.G., Flórez-Orrego, D., Teles dos Santos, M., de Oliveira Jr., S., Maréchal, F., Techno-economic and environmental analysis of methanol and dimethyl ether production from syngas in a kraft pulp process. Computers and Chemical Engineering 163 (2022) 107810, DOI: https://doi.org/10.1016/j.compchemeng.2022.107810

units.unit_description: This unit represents the conversion of 5726.79 kg/h of 2:1 (H/C) co-electrolysis syngas into 4302.79 kg/h of methanol: isothermal synthesis reactor at 210 °C with recycle compressor, flash separation, oxy-fired flare burning the purge with an isothermal radiative section, and a distillation column separating methanol from heavies and water. Roughly 997 COSOEC units feed one methanol unit.
units.connectors_description: The unit takes syngas, oxygen and electricity, and delivers methanol, pure CO2, flue gas condensate and the column bottoms, which go to the waste water treatment unit.

units.heat_streams_description: The heat streams are the heaters, coolers, reactor, flare and distillation column duties of the Aspen Plus model, for the 5726.79 kg/h syngas feed. The flue gas of the flare is split in segments at the condensation onset.

units.unit_description: PLACEHOLDER: dummy waste water treatment of the column bottoms, per kg/h treated. It discharges the treated bottoms as water to the grid. The specific electricity and the 1:1 water recovery are token values, not a design: the unit currently treats water essentially for free and loses nothing to sludge. Replace both before using the results.
